name: Daybreak
subtitle: Calendar wake planning and Clock access experiment

apps.name: Daybreak
apps.versionDescription: The read-only Clock scan now continues saved inode ranges automatically after one tap. Keep Daybreak open while it scans; alarm mutation is not implemented.
apps.localizedDescription: Plan wake times from tomorrow’s calendar and apply through the on-device Siri runner. Calendar data stays on the phone.

apps.name: Daybreak Runner
apps.localizedDescription: Experimental on-device Siri runner. Requires DEVELOPMENT signing with get-task-allow, a signed nested .xctest bundle, a mounted developer image and UI Automation approval. Distribution signing is insufficient. Calendar planning is configured in Daybreak.
apps.versionDescription: Device-tested Siri activation; alarm result and locked-screen reliability require verification.
